rows.en: That's a liiie!
I knew it myself… I'm a half-baked android born in Shadow.
No, that's not true!

When I'm Bijinder, I'm a cold, cruel, evil android…

When I'm in this form, as Mari, I'm a half-measure who just can't do anything bad…
No, the you right now must be the real you! Let me fix you with my own skills, Mari!
No, I can't! Zero-One!

I'm an android born in Shadow… And my mission is to kill you, Zero-One!

Change, Bijinder!

Taaah! Ohohohohoho…

Zero-One, your life is mine!
No… She took my attack and only got this little damage… She's not someone I'd want as an enemy.
What are you doing?
I'm fitting her with a Conscience Circuit!
A Conscience Circuit?

With my skills, it won't be a perfect Conscience Circuit, but…

I at least want to give her as much conscience as Jiro has.
L-look out!

…!?

Shadow!?

Ah, Bijinder's gone!? Damn it!

*Clap, clap!* I, Hanpei, long for love…

May a lovely girl appear before me!

…!?

And here she is already! Muhuhuhu…

Excuse me… If you nap in a place like this, you'll catch cold! If you're going to sleep anyway, why not in my car…
Mmm…
Ah… no, no, no… well… shall I bring you a futon? …A futon!

Kyah!

What do you mean, a futon!? With a face like a floor cushion!
Still, she's just my type… Miss, wait a moment! Miss!

What is it… I was sleeping so nicely!

"Miss"? You mean Sis Misao? Takes all kinds, I guess…

Heh heh heh…

Misao and Hiroshi, I've finally found you! You can't escape now! Come… return to Professor Gill.
Yayaya-ya… Th-the DARK Destruction Squad!?
No way! I'm not going back to the DARK base! Come on, Hiroshi!
Where are they, where are they?
Nngh… Kikaider! Come out!
There he is! Over there!
DARK Destruction Squad's Kaimen Green! You've shown up again!? Today I'll take you down!
Silence, Kikaider! Have you forgotten I'm immortal?
Hanpen! Take care of those two!

Mister Jiro! Even if you ask me that…

M-Miss…!
Hiroshi, run!
Ah… Miss, I beg you, wait…
Uwaaaah… Uuugh…

Kaimen Green… I'll give you one last chance!

Kill Kikaider and bring me Misao and Hiroshi!

Listen! To this devil's flute… Suffer… Suffer, you traitor Kikaider!
Kikaider, you're the one who's going to die! Here I come! Heh heh heh…
Kaimen Green's eerie laughter drowned out the sound of the devil's flute Gill was playing! Jiro changes into Kikaider!
You are…?
Heh heh heh… I told you, I'll come back to life as many times as it takes! Here I come, Kikaider!
This could go on forever! Damn… what am I supposed to do?

…!?

Hakaider!?
This could go on forever! Damn… what am I supposed to do?
Out of the way! I'm the one who'll kill Kikaider! Keep your hands off!
Hakaider! You mean to get in my way?
That's my line! If you don't want to get hurt, get lost, Kaimen Green!
Nngh… I'm reporting this to Gill! You'll pay for this, Hakaider!
Hmph… Now the nuisance is gone! Kikaider, fight me!
Wait! Hakaider, I can't fight you! How many times do I have to tell you?
Wait! Hakaider, I can't fight you! How many times do I have to tell you?
How many times do I have to tell you, Kikaider!? Fight me!

Ugh… damn! I have to replace the blood for my brain with fresh blood! Ngh, after coming this far…

Kikaider! Next time we meet… I'll have your lives for sure!
That was close…
Hanpeeen!
Oh, Lady Mitsuko…
Jiro, Hanpen!
Do you people know this pervert?
Huh…!? A p-pervert?

N-n-no, it's not like that!

Misao… what cruel words. I merely… wished to serve you, like a knight…

Misao?

You're Misao?

Mister Jiro!

I shall take full responsibility for escorting the young lady home, so you devote yourself to searching for Dr. Komyoji…
Dr. Komyoji…?

…!?

I've heard about you from my brother Ichiro… You must be Mari?
I'm…

Mari!

I've been looking for you, all this time…
Taki… You mustn't come looking for someone like me.
Why? Why not? I don't know what your reasons are… but we're both human, aren't we?

…!?

Goodbye, Taki…

H-hey, wait… Mari, wait! Mari!

Did I… say something wrong?

…?

What's wrong, Jiro? You seem kind of down.
It's nothing! Just leave me alone, Mitsuko…

Jiro! Where are you?

What are you doing out here all by yourself? Jiro?

…!?

Jiro! What are you doing!?

If you hit yourself with a high-voltage line, your body… might break down.
Don't stop me! This is the only way to defeat Kaimen Green for good!
What will you do if you die!?
Unless I power up somehow, I can't beat Kaimen Green!
Is Kaimen Green that strong?
Mitsuko, stand back!
Jirooo!
Rieko… DARK and Shadow are after you! You really ought to stay with us after all…

uncertain: U11549: Ichiro about Bijinder after the fight; "she" from context.
U11551-U11553: 良心回路 rendered "Conscience Circuit".
U11556: Hanpei's パンパン (clapping in prayer) rendered "*Clap, clap!*"; 我輩 as "I, Hanpei".
U11557: 寵寝 read as 転寝 "nap"; continuation of Hanpei's line in a narration-kind row.
U11560: pun on futon / zabuton kept as "a face like a floor cushion".
U11571/U11596: ハンペン is Jiro's nickname for Hanpei; kept "Hanpen".
U11578: narration-kind row with a closing bracket but no opening one; translated as narration.
U11579: Kikaider's "君は…？" (You are…?) - addressee unclear (probably the revived Kaimen Green); kept literal.
U11581-U11583: U11583 repeats U11581 without the closing bracket (other route); same translation.
U11592: Hakaider must replace the blood for his (Saburo's) brain.
U11601: 満身 read as 専心 "devote yourself".
U11607: 同じ人間じゃねえか rendered "we're both human" (ironic; Mari is an android).
